name: GasVentRound
vfx_note: bubbles/gas VFX spawn at the mouth centre (rim level), rising along the axis; the hole goes ~0.6-0.7 m down (dark Props vent_hole); rust vent_crust ring + tongues around the mouth. Coordinates are Blender-local (X right, Y = back, Z up; front faces -Y), same frame as the FBX pivot; z = height above the pivot
collider: mound as a convex hull of the Peat object (walkable), mouth area: trigger volume for the gas zone (game side); Plants/Fungus no collider

separate_objects.SW27a_Fungus: Props material; removable mushrooms at the base

pivot: bottom centre; the skirt sinks 0.14 m into the ground
notes: set the mound into the bog so ground_line_z is at the ground surface
